name: Imli Aloo Bukhara Sharbat
description: Tangy-sweet Pakistani imli aloo bukhara sharbat made with tamarind and dried plums, chilled and balanced with sugar and black salt.
method: Soak the tamarind pulp and dried plums in enough warm water to soften them and make the pulp easier to extract.
Mash the softened mixture thoroughly, pressing the tamarind and plums so their flavour moves into the liquid.
Strain through a fine sieve, pressing the pulp, and discard hard seeds and coarse fibres.
Stir in the sugar and black salt while the liquid is still easy to dissolve them into, then add the remaining chilled water.
Chill and taste after dilution; adjust sweetness or tartness gradually because tamarind and dried plums vary naturally.
Stir well and serve over ice.
